intent: Every launcher icon in the shared family occupies the same circle (glyph auto-centred, furthest ink at INK_RADIUS = 340px, stroke width compensated) and every registered app carries a launcher name that the Pixel launcher never truncates.
scope: python_pkg/app_icons only: fit.py, labels.py, _label_widths.py (new); render.py, style.py, cli.py, generate.py, preview.py, _app_icon.py, _apps_more.py, glyphs.py, _glyph_art_extra.py, README.md; their tests
Non-goal: regenerating assets inside the app repos (each app repo commits its own icons); repo_contract label gate in kuhyx/utils is committed separately
changes: fit.py: render, measure ink, derive a Placement that centres the ink box and scales it so the furthest inked pixel sits at style.INK_RADIUS, iterating because stroke width does not scale
style.py: INK_RADIUS = 340px plus ADAPTIVE_CANVAS_DP / INK_RADIUS_DP for vector-drawable consumers (phone-focus-mode)
labels.py + _label_widths.py: LABELS registry and rules (capital first letter, ASCII letters only, <= 10 chars, <= 522 wide in the Pixel launcher font); AppIcon.label reads it
render.py/cli.py: centre_offset, safe_box_overflow and the CLI safe-box warning removed (superseded by the fit)
glyphs/_glyph_art_extra/_apps_more: prompt-bubble (sufler) and camera (macro_cam) glyphs and registry entries
_app_icon.py: labels import moved to module top level (no cycle: labels imports only _label_widths) to satisfy PLC0415/C0415

verification.evidence: 126 passed in 7.24s; every python_pkg/app_icons/*.py file at 100% line+branch (fit.py 37 stmts/8 branches, labels.py 21/10, cli.py 66/20, render.py 36/2)
first run: no-noqa, ruff PLC0415 and pylint C0415 failed on the lazy import in _app_icon.py; after moving it top-level, 38 hooks Passed, 0 failed

verification.command: python3 -m python_pkg.app_icons list && python3 -m python_pkg.app_icons preview -o /dev/shm/appicons_prev/sheet.png
verification.evidence: list shows sufler -> prompt-bubble +linux and macro_cam -> camera; preview wrote sheet.png with all 25 glyphs at visually equal size on the charcoal field

risks: Glyph sizes change for every app, so each app repo shows an icon diff the next time it regenerates

rollback: Rerun the app_icons pytest command above and the preview to confirm the old sizes return
